_help: Whistle's default mappings: Herdr's own commands only. An update replaces this file; put yours in ~/.config/herdr-app/whistle.json ({ "enabled", "hints", "map" }), which goes over these and over the layout's "mappings" prop. A key set to null removes it.
map: key -> [label, command] or [label, command, {args}], or a group {name, map} whose keys follow (w v).
Commands keep you in WHISTLE; a 4th item "type" ends in TYPE instead: [label, command, null, "type"].
Keys: the character typed (p, /, +, ?) or a key name (space, enter, tab), with ctrl-/alt-/super- in front as in keys.json (ctrl-n). Groups nest; the leader is the group on space.
A mapped key wins over the built-in WHISTLE keys (i, h/j/k/l, ctrl-h/j/k/l, arrows, enter, and the keys a field handles itself), so leave those free.
command: any `herdr-app commands` name; name:value fills its first argument, as in keys.json.

whistle.field:<block> selects the field in that layout block; whistle.focus:<block> shows the block and selects it; whistle.toggle:<block> shows it or takes it away; whistle.settings opens whistle's settings.
Esc cancels, Backspace goes back one level.
